title: Trimukh Maroti Kirkan v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Trimukh Maroti Kirkan v. State of Maharashtra, (2006) 10 SCC 681
content.holding: Operationalized the interplay between Section 104 and Section 109 BSA in custodial and matrimonial homicides: once the prosecution establishes that the victim died an unnatural death inside a private residence in the exclusive presence of the accused, the evidential onus shifts to the accused to explain.
content.relevance: Leading authority on circumstantial burden-shifting in closed-dwelling offences.
